findings.title: File is missing from a ConfigMap or Secret volume
findings.cause: container web runs /scripts/start.sh, which does not exist: ConfigMap scripts, mounted at /scripts, has no key start.sh (it has run.sh); Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "/scripts/start.sh": stat /scripts/start.sh: no such file or directory

evidence.what: container web mounts volume scripts (ConfigMap scripts) at /scripts

findings.fix: Add key start.sh to ConfigMap scripts, or point the app at a file the volume has.
